verses.1: And when David sat in his house, he said to the prophet Nathan, “Look, I am sitting in the house of the cedars, and the covenant of Jehovah is under its cover.”
verses.2: And Nathan said to David, “Do everything that is in your heart, for God is with you.”
verses.3: And in that night, God spoke to Nathan.
verses.4: Go and say to David, my servant: “As the LORD has said, you will not build me a house for me to dwell in.”
verses.5: For I have not sat in the house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt until today. I will go from one tent to another, from one dwelling place to another.
verses.6: In all the places I traveled throughout Israel, I said these words to one of Israel’s judges. I ordered him to tell my people, “Why haven’t you built me a house of cedar?”
verses.7: And now, thus shall it be said to my servant David: “Thus says the LORD Almighty: I will take you from among the sheep, from behind the flock, so that you may be judge over my people Israel.”
verses.8: And I will be with you in everything you do. I will remove all your enemies from before you. I will give you a name equal to that of the great ones who have lived on this earth.
verses.9: And I gave a place to my people, Israel, and I planted them there. They could live under my rule, without being oppressed anymore. And the children of Avla would no longer be able to harm them, as they once did.
verses.10: And in those days, when I commanded judges over my people Israel, and I subdued all your enemies, then I will also build a house for you, O LORD.
verses.11: And it shall be that your days will be long; you will be able to go with your fathers. I will set your descendants in their places, and I will prepare their kingdom for them.
verses.12: He will build a house for me, and I will set up its altar forever.
verses.13: I will be his father, and he will be my son. My kindness will not be taken away from him, just as I took them away from those who were before you.
verses.14: And he shall stand in my house and in my kingdom forever. And his throne shall endure forever.
verses.15: All these things, and all these visions, were spoken by Nathan to David.
verses.16: And King David came and sat down before Jehovah. He said, “Who am I, Jehovah God? And who is my house, that you have brought me here?”
verses.17: May this be seen by your eyes, O God! May You speak to Your servants from afar. May You see me as a human being, O LORD God.
verses.18: What else can David do to honor you? You know very well who your servant is.
verses.19: You, LORD, through your servants and dogs, have done all these wonderful things in order to show us all the wonders that exist.
verses.20: Yehová is without equal; there is no other god like Him. He is the one we have heard from our own ears.
verses.21: And among your people, Israel, there is one nation on this earth whom God has chosen to be a people of greatness and glory. They will be a nation that will rise above your people, who were rescued from Egypt.
verses.22: And you gave your people, Israel, to you as a people forever. And you, Jehovah, became their God.
verses.23: And now, LORD, may what you have said about your servants and their homes be fulfilled forever. May it be done as you have said.
verses.24: And may your name be honored and glorified forever. May it be said, “The Lord, the God of Israel, is the God of Israel. And David’s house will be loyal to you before your face.”
verses.25: For you, O Lord, have made your servant’s ear to hear prayers. Thus, your servant can pray before you.
verses.26: And now, Jehovah, you are that God. Speak therefore to your good servant.
verses.27: And now, bless your servant’s house, so that it may be blessed forever before you. For you, LORD, bless and grant peace forever.
